groups.text:
Steps · Video Streaming Fundamentals

Add, reorder, edit, or remove the steps shown on this journey's public page.

Add step
1
Introduction to Video Streaming

Get oriented with the core concepts of digital video delivery: containers, codecs, bitrates, and how a video gets from a camera to a viewer's screen.

3 linked resources:
VIDEO ENCODING 101: A BEGINNER'S GUIDE TO KEY CONCEPTS
STREAMING LEARNING CENTER'S BEGINNER'S GUIDE TO LIVE STREAMING
HOW TO STREAM VIDEO: A BEGINNER'S GUIDE
2
Understanding Video Codecs

Compare H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1. Learn why codec choice impacts quality, file size, device support and licensing cost.

3 linked resources:
DECODING THE VIDEO CODEC WARS: H.264, HEVC, AND AV1 COMPARED FOR STREAMING
GUIDE TO HEVC/H.265 ENCODING AND PLAYBACK
AV1 ENCODING WITH LIBSVTAV1 ON QENCODE
3
Streaming Protocols Overview

Walk through HLS, DASH, RTMP and WebRTC. Understand which protocol fits live, on-demand and ultra-low-latency use cases.

2 linked resources:
FFMPEG WIKI: STREAMING GUIDE
WOWZA: STREAMING PROTOCOLS OVERVIEW
4
Players and Playback Basics

Explore how HTML5 players, MSE and adaptive bitrate switching deliver smooth playback across devices and network conditions.

1 linked resource:
RDK VIDEO GUIDE — AAMP PLAYER AND GSTREAMER PIPELINE DEBUGGING
5
Video Formats and Containers

Demystify MP4, fMP4, MKV, WebM and TS containers — what they hold, when to use each, and how they pair with codecs.

1 linked resource:
WEB-DEMUXER
6
Putting It All Together

Trace a complete streaming pipeline from ingest to playback so you can reason about every link in the chain before going deeper.

3 linked resources:
BEST PRACTICES FOR END-TO-END WORKFLOW MONITORING
LIVE STREAMING ARCHITECTURE: INGEST, TRANSCODING, AND DELIVERY AT SCALE
REBUILDING NETFLIX VIDEO PROCESSING PIPELINE WITH MICROSERVICES
Close
